audit.whatIsWrong: Every phase reason is shared template text keyed to 'Justice Punch's cooldown' and says nothing specific to Galio.
audit.why: Shield of Durand (18s) is what actually decides trades — Akali's damage is entirely magic and his channel cuts it — while Justice Punch is 11s at rank 1 and needs a champion to hit.
audit.corrected: Phase reasons rewritten around Shield of Durand's channel, Justice Punch's target requirement and Hero's Entrance's map role.

audit.whatIsWrong: The first-item and 2-item spikes were generic and never said what changes about the lane.
audit.why: Akali's first item lets her go E in, R out inside one Shield of Durand cooldown; Galio's real spike is level 6 Hero's Entrance, which is map pressure rather than lane pressure.
audit.corrected: phases[4], phases[5] and phases[6] now name Hero's Entrance's 180s, the E-in R-out pattern and the teamfight limit.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive split was never stated: Twilight Shroud blanks his targeted taunt and his Justice Punch dash, but Winds of War is ground-cast and keeps burning you inside the smoke.
audit.why: Twilight Shroud makes Akali unable to be selected — Justice Punch needs a champion to dash to, and the Shield of Durand taunt needs a target. Winds of War is a ground zone and selects nothing. Confirmed from the opposite side in audits/top/galio__akali.json.
audit.corrected: Stated in phases[1].why, phases[3].why, dosFull[2].d, breakdown.cooldowns and report[5].t.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers in the full layer, and the one named cooldown was the wrong ability.
audit.why: Shield of Durand 18/17/16/15/14, Justice Punch 11/10/9/8/7, Winds of War 11s at rank 1, Hero's Entrance 180s at rank 1; your Q costs 110 energy at rank 1 and Perfect Execution is 120s.
audit.corrected: Numbers added to tldr, phases[2], phases[3], phases[4], phases[5], breakdown.cooldowns and both dosFull/dontsFull entries.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull and dontsFull descriptions did not match their own titles — 'Waste energy on the wave' was described as 'burning it for tiny value'.
audit.corrected: Each description rewritten to explain its own title, with Akali's real 110 energy cost at Q rank 1.

edits.before: Bait his key tool — shroud his Justice Punch and burst the gap. Akali wins the Justice Punch cooldown windows.
edits.after: Bait Shield of Durand — your damage is all magic and his 18s channel eats it. Punish him in the gap after.

edits.before: Shroud his Justice Punch and burst the gap. Track Justice Punch before every commit and keep the wave on your side.
edits.after: Shroud his Justice Punch — the dash needs a champion to hit, so it lands on nothing and the lane is yours.

edits.before: Q-poke on energy rhythm wins the chip war. Identify how Galio contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Winds of War reaches 825 to your 550 kunai and your Q costs 110 energy at rank 1 — nobody engages here.

edits.before: Shroud rewrites any trade he starts. Only take the trade when Galio's Justice Punch is down.
edits.after: Shroud blanks his taunt and his punch, but ground-cast Winds of War keeps burning you inside it.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Galio must walk into your range.
edits.after: Full kit online: bait Shield of Durand (18s) with a kunai, then E-mark and dash in while the channel is spent.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Justice Punch's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: The lane-control window: Justice Punch is 11s at rank 1 and needs a champion to hit — stand in the smoke and it finds nothing.

edits.before: Both R casts turn survived all-ins into executes. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Galio's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Both R casts execute, but Hero's Entrance (180s) wins the map rather than the lane — shove and watch for his flight.

edits.before: Lich Bane is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Justice Punch's cooldown.
edits.after: Lich Bane is your spike — E in and R out, and one Shield of Durand cannot cover both.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Galio carry threat 6/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on: you execute out of the smoke, but his ultimate is a teamfight — do not let the game stall into it.

edits.before: - Galio Justice Punch: matchup-defining — His dash + knockup engage. Punish him when it's down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Justice Punch (11s at rank 1): the dash needs a champion, so smoke blanks it. - Shield of Durand (18s): the channel cuts your magic burst and taunts — bait it out. - Hero's Entrance (180s): map pressure, not lane pressure.

edits.before: Q Galio at max blade range, E-dash the angle when his answer is down, and shroud the return fire.
edits.after: Q him at 550, bait Shield of Durand with the kunai, then E-mark and dash the angle behind him.

edits.before: Diving with no shroud and no energy — Akali without resources is a melee mage with paper armor.
edits.after: Committing into a charged Shield of Durand — it cuts your magic burst and taunts you at the end.

edits.before: Q Galio at max blade range, E-dash the angle when his answer is down, and shroud the return fire.
edits.after: Five Point Strike costs 110 energy at rank 1 — poke on the regen, not on every step he takes.

edits.before: Galio wastes Justice Punch — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: The punch needs a champion to hit; drop smoke and it finds nothing.

edits.before: That is Galio's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: His W taunt turns a naked commit of yours into one free full rotation on you.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Q costs 110 energy at rank 1 — spend it on him, not on minions.

edits.before: Diving with no shroud and no energy — Akali without resources is a melee mage with paper armor.
edits.after: Perfect Execution is 120s at rank 1 — cast one is not poke, it is half of your kill window.

edits.before: Track Galio's Justice Punch: His dash + knockup engage. Punish him when it's down. When it is down — Shroud his answer, Q-burst.
edits.after: Justice Punch needs a champion to hit, so smoke blanks it; Shield of Durand cuts your magic burst — bait the channel.
